question.prompt: In a figure placed horizontally, a line segment parallel to the horizontal axis has length 6. What length should this segment have in the pictorial drawing?

solutions.explanation:
Under the recorded school oblique-dimetric convention with no additional scaling, the length of a line segment parallel to the horizontal axis remains unchanged. Thus its drawn length is \(6\).

The displayed question does not specify this convention or scale. A half-size copy of that drawing would have length \(3\), so the answer \(6\) depends on the recorded convention.
solutions.title: Apply the qualified horizontal-length rule
